fact: 杨格计划于1929年2月至6月在巴黎由欧文·杨领导的国际金融专家委员会谈成，六国政府于6月原则上同意。赔款本金定为360亿帝国马克、偿付至1988年，含利息总额1120亿帝国马克，年均约20亿帝国马克（1929年约合4.73亿美元）；计划1930年5月17日生效，追溯至1929年9月1日。海牙会议第一次会议为1929年8月6日至31日，正式签署在1930年1月20日。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Young Plan
sources.quote: the Young Plan was negotiated in Paris from February to June 1929 by a committee of international financial experts under the leadership of American businessman and economist Owen D. Young. ... Reparations were set at 36 billion Reichsmarks payable through 1988. Including interest, the total came to 112 billion Reichsmarks. ... The average annual payment was approximately two billion Reichsmarks (US$473 million in 1929). ... The plan came into effect on 17 May 1930, retroactive to 1 September 1929.

fact: 1929年10月16日，反对杨格计划的「自由法」提案正式提出；帝国议会以318票对82票否决该案。随后的公民投票中，赞成票占有效票94.5%，但投票率仅14.9%，即只有13.8%的合格选民投赞成票，未达通过所需的全体合格选民50%，公投失败。这次动员把赔款问题重新推上街头政治的中心。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Young Plan
sources.quote: The Freedom Law proposal was officially presented on 16 October 1929. The committee succeeded in collecting enough signatures to put the proposal before the Reichstag, which voted the bill down by a 318–82 margin. In the subsequent Freedom Law referendum, 94.5% of the votes cast were in favour of the proposed law, but voter turnout was just 14.9%, meaning that only 13.8% of eligible voters had voted in favour of the law. The referendum therefore failed, since it needed 50% of all eligible voters to pass.

fact: 1929年5月1日至3日，柏林警方在韦丁（Wedding）与新克尔恩（Neukölln）工人区驱散五一出游与集会人群，出动1.3万至1.65万名警员，使用警棍、水龙、装甲车并开枪，冲突持续到5月3日下午。事后核定死亡32至38人（导言与信息框记33人），全部为平民，除一人被警车撞死外均死于警方枪弹；另有约200人受伤、约1200人被捕，其中仅66人被起诉。死者中有8名女性，前25名死者中2人为社民党党员、17人无党籍，无一人是德共党员。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Blutmai
sources.quote: 1–3 May 1929 ... An estimated 33 civilians, none of whom were involved with the KPD, were killed, 200 injured, and over a thousand people taken into police custody ... It was determined that between 32 and 38 people were killed, all civilians, and all by police firearms save for one individual who was struck by a speeding police van. Around 200 were injured and approximately 1,200 arrested, of whom only 66 were ever charged.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Blutmai，Aftermath与Events小节
sources.quote: The Berlin police, which had mobilized between 13,000 and 16,500 officers, dispersed small street gatherings either by giving the order for them to do so or, more frequently, with the use of batons. ... Eight of the civilians killed were women and 19 were residents of Wedding. Of the first 25 victims, two were SPD members and 17 belonged to no party; none were KPD members.

fact: 1929年10月底华尔街崩盘引发的世界性大萧条，对德国的打击除美国外最重。关键机制是德国对美国贷款的深度依赖：至1931年前流入德国的206亿马克外国贷款中约有一半为短期；华尔街崩盘后美国银行开始收回贷款，德国随之爆发资本危机。德国工业在1929年上半年仍在投资，订单骤降后立即出现严重产能过剩。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in Germany
sources.quote: The worldwide Great Depression triggered by the Wall Street crash of late October 1929 hit Germany harder than any country except the United States. ... of the 20.6 billion marks in foreign loans that came into Germany before 1931, roughly half were short term. When American banks began calling in the loans after the Wall Street crash, it caused a major capital crisis in Germany. ... German industry, which had still been investing in the first part of 1929, faced significant overcapacity as orders plummeted.

fact: 德国1927年建立政府失业保险：雇主与雇员等额缴费，失业者领取26周保险金，期满后须依赖地方福利救济；制度按最多140万人设计。1929年初它覆盖了80%的失业者，到1932年1月只覆盖30%，其余人落入地方救济或完全没有收入。对穿越者而言，这意味着柏林的「失业保险」在1929年尚可用，1930年后迅速失效。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in Germany
sources.quote: Germany had introduced a government program of unemployment insurance in 1927, the year when per capita GDP exceeded pre-war levels for the first time. Paid for equally by employers and employees, the insurance covered 26 weeks of unemployment, after which the unemployed had to rely on welfare at the local level. The system, funded to handle up to 1.4 million people, was overwhelmed by the massive increase in the number of unemployed after the depression began. At the start of 1929, it was covering 80% of the unemployed; by January 1932, that had sunk to 30%.

fact: 「血腥五月」之后，柏林没有任何针对警方行为的官方调查，也没有一名警员被起诉；被捕的约1200人中只有66人被起诉。警方在事件中立即对德共主要报纸《红旗》（Die Rote Fahne）实施七周禁令。这说明1929年魏玛共和国的街头执法在实践中几乎不受司法审查，参加游行的外国人与无党籍旁观者同样在射界之内。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Blutmai
sources.quote: There was no official investigation into the police assaults and no police officer was charged. ... They immediately imposed a seven-week ban on the primary Communist newspaper Die Rote Fahne ... The police used personnel carriers and armoured cars, occasionally aiming their weapons at residences and firing on civilian onlookers.

fact: 魏玛宪法下的公民投票（Volksbegehren/Volksentscheid）门槛极高：法案须获得全体合格选民的过半数赞成方能通过，而非赞成票占投票数的多数。1929年10月反杨格计划公投即因投票率仅14.9%、赞成者只占合格选民13.8%而失败，尽管赞成票占有效票94.5%。这一制度设计使少数派动员很难转化为法律结果。

fact: 以1924—1926年为100的德国股价指数：1929年134、1930年109、1931年81、1932年55、1933年67。也就是说德国股市的年度均价在1929年仍高于1928年，崩盘要到1930年才在年均值上体现；至1932年德国股价较1929年下跌约59%。用「1929年10月崩盘」直接推演德国股市当年的跌幅会得出错误结论。

fact: 杨格计划取消了道威斯计划的「转移保护」：德国此后须自行保证以税收募集的资金能以外国货币或实物转移给国际清算银行。支付义务分为两部分——无保护份额固定为6亿帝国马克，任何情况下都必须以外国货币转移；受保护份额金额为其两倍多，在「较短萧条」情况下可先以帝国马克转移，但外币须在两年内交付。这使德国的外汇敞口在1929年后成为刚性约束。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Young Plan
sources.quote: The transfer protection of the Dawes Plan was abolished, meaning that in the future, Germany was responsible for ensuring that the sum raised from tax revenue could be transferred in foreign currency or in kind to the Bank for International Settlements. ... The remaining payment obligation in foreign currency was divided into an unprotected installment, which had to be transferred in foreign currency under all circumstances and amounted to a constant 600 million Reichsmarks.

fact: 1925年12月2日，巴斯夫（27.4%股本）、拜耳（27.4%）、赫斯特（含卡塞拉与卡勒，27.4%）、爱克发（9%）、格里斯海姆—电子（6.9%）与魏勒—特尔—梅尔（1.9%）六家合并成立IG法本（I.G. Farben）。1926年其市值14亿帝国马克、员工10万人。合并前这八家企业在1913年生产了世界染料供应量的近90%，并把约80%的产量销往国外——德国化学工业的卡特尔式集中是1929年前后出口竞争力的组织基础。

sources.title: Wikipedia, IG Farben
sources.quote: Following a contract signed by all concerned parties on November 21, 1925, IG Farben was founded on December 2, 1925, as a merger of six companies: BASF (27.4 percent of equity capital); Bayer (27.4 percent); Hoechst, including Cassella and Chemische Fabrik Kalle (27.4 percent); Agfa (9 percent); Chemische Fabrik Griesheim-Elektron (6.9 percent); and Chemische Fabrik vorm. Weiler Ter Meer (1.9 percent). ... In 1926, IG Farben had a market capitalization of 1.4 billion ℛ︁ℳ︁ ... and a workforce of 100,000 ... In 1913, these eight firms produced almost 90 percent of the world supply of dyestuffs and sold about 80 percent of their production abroad.

fact: 1929年上半年德国工业仍在扩大投资，10月崩盘后订单骤降，重工业与建筑业出现严重产能过剩，成为裁员最集中的部门；到1932年重工业与建筑工人以及18—30岁青年失业最严重，60%的大学毕业生报告失业。产能过剩与失业互为因果，构成1929—1932年德国「投资—订单—裁员」的下行螺旋。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in Germany
sources.quote: German industry, which had still been investing in the first part of 1929, faced significant overcapacity as orders plummeted. Production shrank, workers were let go and some firms collapsed. A self-reinforcing downward spiral followed ... Hardest hit were workers in heavy industry and the building trades, along with 18 to 30 year olds. Sixty percent of university graduates were reported to be out of work
